verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide lists a 'Run Windows on your Mac' topic, so official guidance on running Windows exists. However, the evidence is only a topic title and does not say whether this means a virtual machine, dual-boot, or third-party software. Missing for 10: confirmation that Windows runs in a VM (rather than dual-boot), details on the virtualization method and any third-party tools required, hardware/architecture support, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
